name: remote-desktop
description: View and control the remote machine's desktop in a VS Code tab, over the existing Remote-SSH / Tunnel connection.

commands.title: Open Test Desktop (built-in fake VNC server)
Install Full-Access Mode (UAC prompts, lock screen)…

enumDescriptions: Windows: full-access mode if installed, otherwise application mode. Other systems: custom.
Windows: run TightVNC as an ordinary program while a desktop tab is open. No admin rights; no UAC prompts or lock screen.
Windows: use the full-access TightVNC service (install it with "Install Full-Access Mode").
Connect to an existing VNC server at remoteDesktop.host / remoteDesktop.port.
remoteDesktop.server.description: Which VNC server the desktop tab connects to.

remoteDesktop.host.description: Custom mode: VNC server host, as seen from the remote machine. Keep this as localhost unless you know you need otherwise.

remoteDesktop.port.description: Custom mode: VNC server port, as seen from the remote machine.

remoteDesktop.scaleToFit.description: Scale the remote desktop to fit the tab.
